newsitem.title: CHINA: China city to let foreign banks try RMB business.
newsitem.headline: China city to let foreign banks try RMB business.

text.p: China is to allow foreign banks in the Pudong area of Shanghai to conduct business in renminbi on a trial basis by the end of the year, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
Shanghai mayor Xu Kuangdi announced the planned move at an international consultancy meeting in the city, Xinhua said.
Domestic banks have been fearful of new competition and have sought to slow down the entry of foreign rivals into the market.
Xinhua also said foreign trade regulations would be liberalised for domestic and foreign companies operating in the Waigaoqiao bonded zone of Pudong, but gave no details.
The Pudong area in eastern Shanghai has been the focus of economic growth in the region, with foreign businesses there enjoying preferential investment and trade policies.
